title: India just had its best August for car sales ever recorded.

sources.text: Business Standard, 2026 - Domestic passenger vehicle dispatches rise 36.5% to 4,39,309 units in August
The Tribune, 2026 - India produces over 31.57 lakh vehicles in August, passenger vehicle sales rise 36.5% (SIAM)

caption:
India just had its best August for car sales ever recorded.

SIAM (Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers) reported domestic passenger vehicle dispatches rose 36.5% year-on-year to 4,39,309 units in August 2026 - the highest-ever August figure on record.

Utility vehicles jumped 39.2% year-on-year to 2,50,084 units. Two-wheelers also posted their best-ever August, up 10.5% to 20.35 lakh units - total vehicle production across all categories crossed 31.57 lakh units for the month.

Cars, two-wheelers and three-wheelers all posted record or near-record growth in the same month - a broad signal about what people are actually buying, not just one segment having a good quarter.
